instruction: Check tuition payment status and, if unpaid, add Stella and Nancy's emails to the recipient field of the drafted payment reminder.

metadata.explanation: Task requires reading tuition_payment.xlsx to find specific students (Stella and Nancy) and verify they haven't paid, then adding their email addresses to the To field in Thunderbird. Verified with Python: Stella (row 20) and Nancy (row 15) both have payment status 'No'. Evaluator checks for their presence in the To field using accessibility tree selectors. Uses existing check_accessibility_tree metric.
metadata.verification_details: Processed complete Excel file (27 rows): Verified Stella and Nancy are among the 4 unpaid students with emails stella@someuniversity.edu and nancy@someuniversity.edu.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses accessibility tree to verify email recipients in Thunderbird compose window
Accessibility tree selectors properly target the To field email address pills (tool-bar[attr|id=MsgHeadersToolbar] label[name=To]~[attr|class="address-pill"])
Complete coverage: checks for both required email addresses (stella@someuniversity.edu and nancy@someuniversity.edu)
Expected values are verified from actual Excel data: Stella (row 20) and Nancy (row 15) confirmed as unpaid students
Postconfig includes 10-second sleep to allow Thunderbird UI to stabilize before accessibility tree extraction
Getter (get_accessibility_tree) and metric (check_accessibility_tree) are correctly paired for UI state verification
Selectors use name*= (contains) which is appropriate since name attributes may include additional text beyond email
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The postconfig only uses sleep for state stability. While acceptable, consider whether the compose window state is guaranteed to be preserved during agent execution
